listing.name: TimeSplitters — Timesplitters (GTTeancum)
listing.summary: The project describes native recompilation with four-player multiplayer screenshots and controller/save claims. Linux was tested under WSL. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS20090 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Runtime release zip/tar + own disc; Xbox requires Windows Prepare Xbox Files utility/build.

warnings: The project describes native recompilation with four-player multiplayer screenshots and controller/save claims. Linux was tested under WSL.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.

references.title: Prepare your disc once and keep the memory cards
references.instruction: Open timesplitters.exe on Windows or ./timesplitters on Linux from the extracted folder. Put your own USA SLUS-200.90 PS2 dump in that folder. Choose Launch game to extract it on the first run. Later launches reuse game-data. Keep all of game-data, including mc0 and mc1, and keep timesplitters.ini when you replace the upstream package. The Linux build needs glibc 2.43 or later, OpenGL 3.3 and X11.

references.title: Start directly using saved Linux settings
references.instruction: After completing upstream setup, use ./timesplitters --no-launcher to resume with the saved settings. Open ./timesplitters without the switch to return to the settings launcher.
